name: ogxo-route
description: Cost-aware routing for Claude Code: a routing skill and session-start summary that tell the main session which tier handles which task, worker subagents pinned to Sonnet or Haiku with explicit tool lists, hooks that warn when a generic subagent is dispatched without a model, log each dispatch and permission request, and count advisor calls, plus opt-in alerts when Claude Code waits on a permission prompt and an opt-in live HTML board of a session's agents and tool calls. Core-risk work and reviews stay at Opus or above; contained risk may run on Sonnet or grok and then gets the Opus review. Warns, never blocks. Requires jq. In Codex, the routing skill and seven worker procedures install without the hooks, alerts, or board.
